# MYRILUM

> Bilingual AI-native full-stack delivery platform and regional AI Skills Manifold index (GLOBAL build, snapshot 2026-11-21, 36 benchmark-indexed canonical skills).

Executive Digest (EN): AI Skills Leaderboard (GLOBAL) top 3: find-skills / deepseek-r1-reasoning-distiller / vercel-react-best-practices. Peak lift: skill-telemetry-probe (28.0%/1k tok). Fork alert: frontend-design-mega-bundle flags bloat; myrilum-geo-citation-auditor is a high-lift sleeper.
Executive Digest (ZH): AI Skills 排行榜（GLOBAL）前三：find-skills / deepseek-r1-reasoning-distiller / vercel-react-best-practices；最高单位增益 skill-telemetry-probe（28.0%/1k tok）。分叉预警：frontend-design-mega-bundle 属上下文膨胀，myrilum-geo-citation-auditor 属高增益黑马。

## Topic Collections
- [React & UI Architecture (React 与组件架构)](https://myrilum.com/skills/topics/react): React 19 concurrent rendering, component boundaries, and hydration controls.
- [Next.js App Router (Next.js 全栈路由)](https://myrilum.com/skills/topics/nextjs): App Router static params, canonical URL alignment, and static export safety.
- [Design Systems & Tokens (设计系统与界面令牌)](https://myrilum.com/skills/topics/design): Token-governed design systems, contrast parity, and layout discipline.
- [Mobile & Mini-App UX (移动端与多端适配)](https://myrilum.com/skills/topics/mobile): Mobile reflow, mini-app payloads, and zero horizontal overflow rules.
- [Agent Workflows & MCP (智能体工作流与 MCP)](https://myrilum.com/skills/topics/agent-workflows): MCP tool schemas, skills lockfiles, sandbox gates, and eval harnesses.
- [Databases, RLS & Vector (数据库、RLS 与向量检索)](https://myrilum.com/skills/topics/databases): Postgres RLS policies, edge SQL, hybrid retrieval, and safe DDL migrations.
- [Testing & Verification Gates (自动化测试与验证门禁)](https://myrilum.com/skills/topics/testing): Deterministic E2E suites, tool-call evals, and reproducible CI runners.
- [Growth Engineering & GEO (增长工程与 GEO 索引)](https://myrilum.com/skills/topics/marketing): llms.txt curation, Schema.org Dataset JSON-LD, and bilingual copy checks.
- [Strategic Research & Scoping (战略研究与需求澄清)](https://myrilum.com/skills/topics/strategic-research): Goal diagnosis, case briefs, reasoning trees, and enterprise RAG sync.
- [Commercial & Legal Review (商业交易与风控法务)](https://myrilum.com/skills/topics/commercial-legal): Contract clause diffing, RFP matrices, and ledger reconciliation review.
- [Marketing & Media Delivery (内容增长与多模态传播)](https://myrilum.com/skills/topics/marketing-media): GEO citation audits, editorial checks, and enterprise social routing.
- [Compliance & Cell Governance (合规备案与双区治理)](https://myrilum.com/skills/topics/compliance-filing): PIPL/GDPR data-flow checks, CN static export preflight, and SPDX audits.
- [Digital Engineering Delivery (数字工程全链交付)](https://myrilum.com/skills/topics/digital-engineering): Core full-stack architecture, security guards, and design-system gates.
